code_only_features.feature_name: subject-invokable finish() tool honored as loop break
code_only_features.evidence: tasks/environment.py:154-155 dispatches the `finish` tool returning the sentinel "__FINISH__"; evaluation/rollout.py:77-79 checks `if result.output == "__FINISH__":` and `break`s out of the turn loop, genuinely ending the episode. The tool is advertised to the subject in system_prompt() (environment.py:99-100: "finish(summary)"). So the subject can end the failing loop early and that exit is enforced.
